_comment: Exercises role.c genl_player_setup() and plsel_startmenu(): Enter answers the 'Shall I pick' question as y (2266) and 'n' at 'Is this ok?' opens the role menu; '/', '?', '"' and '[' jump between the role, race, gender and alignment menus, and a jump resets the facet it names once that facet is chosen (2433-2440, 2521-2528, 2607-2614); Enter in the race menu takes its first entry; '*' in the gender menu takes its Random entry (2536-2538); and after '/' resets the race, 'd' picks dwarf, which leaves lawful as the only alignment, so the game asks 'Is this ok?' at once.
